sentences: PosSLP asks whether the integer produced by an arithmetic straight-line program is positive.
The program can represent integers far too large to expand explicitly, so evaluating the sign is a succinct arithmetic problem.
The source relates this task to divisibility, equality, order, and representations as sums of squares.
The selected question asks for unconditional hardness results for PosSLP.
Such results would clarify the intrinsic difficulty of exact numerical comparisons without depending on number-theoretic conjectures used in some of the paper's reductions.
